attributes.title: tag_write
attributes.description: Write current Tag values via system.tag.writeBlocking: one bounded batch, scalars and arrays of scalars only (Dataset and Document values are invalid_argument). The per-item Native outcome is the result's QualityCode; a bounded read-back is returned as Observed state and never decides success. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a target outside the tag_write Target allowlist, or inside the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), fails with permission_denied before anything executes. Preflight checks every item before any item runs, with no rollback. Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-write audit reports auditRecorded=false and stays a success. D28 ignition-null-v1 encodes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}. D10: the documented default batch is 20 items and the hard maximum is 100. Example: {"writes":[{"path":"[default]AHU/AHU01/Setpoint","value":22}]}.

parameters.name: writes
parameters.description: 1..100 write items: {"path": provider-qualified current Tag value path, "value": scalar or array of scalars}. Default 20 (D10), hard maximum 100.
